speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. To help me understand your symptoms better, can you tell me if you have noticed any swollen lymph nodes or an enlarged abdomen? Also, has the fever been persistent or does it come and go?

speaker: Patient
text: 4-year-old girl. The patient has been experiencing generalized fatigue and easy bruising for 3 weeks. Over the past week, she has developed a fever and severe leg pain that wakes her up at night.

speaker: Doctor
text: I notice you haven't mentioned the lymph nodes or abdomen yet; have you observed any swelling in her neck, armpits, or groin, or does her belly feel enlarged or tender to the touch? Additionally, are the bruises widespread and accompanied by any bleeding from the gums or nose?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Generalized fatigue and easy bruising. I also have Fever, Severe leg pain that disturbs sleep.

speaker: Doctor
text: I need to clarify if you have noticed any enlarged lymph nodes, an enlarged liver or spleen, or any bleeding from the gums or nose. Also, does the leg pain worsen with movement or is it constant regardless of activity?
